items.title: Wall Street Is Divided on Tesla’s Next Move: Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: Tesla just posted record deliveries and a massive revenue beat while simultaneously cratering its own earnings and flipping free cash flow negative. Wall Street's 47 analysts cannot agree on what that contradiction means, and the next move in shares may hinge on one number most investors are not watching.
